ctx.x: What about somebody like Punch who's traveled a lot and been away more or less since the 20s? Do you think it changed his philosophy or his style?

Oh yeah, I think it changed Punch a lot. I think Punch from the records that I've heard of Punch is so completely different than what he plays now. He wouldn't know it was the same guy. I mean even the tone. I wonder, I'm just curious if that's what would happen to all normal musicians if they had to go and travel and play with different styles of bands. But the guys that were really solid, all the good bands and the whole history of jazz music had some New Orleans men in them affecting that band. From Duke…
You know the Al Cooper, Savoy, Sultans had a New Orleans drummer in them.
